title.narrative: Promoting Environment and Community Economy (PEACE Project))

description.narrative: The Promoting Environment and Community Economy (PEACE) Project is implemented by the Small Producers Development and Transporters Association (SPRODETA) in the Chisenga and Mphompha Extension Planning Areas of Rumphi and Chitipa districts, Malawi. The project's main purpose is to strengthen sustainable livelihoods, resilience, and gender equality for 3,000 direct beneficiaries (1,800 women and 1,200 men), including single mothers, widows, and other vulnerable people. Key activities include capacity building in agro-ecology and business management, promoting income diversification through bean, potato, and banana value chains, establishing Village Savings and Loan Associations (VSLAs), facilitating women's access to land and justice through village tribunals and mobile courts, and strengthening SPRODETA's institutional capacity. The overall goal is to combat food insecurity and poverty exacerbated by climate shocks, market inaccessibility, and gender inequality
